summary: First iteration: Tested Dynasty 8 backend (22 pytest tests, all green) and frontend (login, dashboard, new sale calculator, my sales, admin panel charts/CSV/XLSX, activity log, RBAC redirect). All critical flows work. No blocking bugs found.

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount (ResponsiveContainer before layout). Non-blocking; charts render after layout. Consider adding min-h to chart wrappers.

action_items: Optional: add minHeight to recharts ResponsiveContainer parents in AdminPanel to silence width(-1)/height(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses synchronous `requests.get` inside async /auth/session (blocks event loop). Switch to httpx.AsyncClient.
CORS_ORIGINS default is '*' combined with allow_credentials=True; browsers reject. Ensure prod sets explicit origin.
log_activity wraps every write but lacks try/except — failures would 500 the parent endpoint.
server.py is ~600 lines and growing; consider splitting into routers (auth, sales, stats, export).
test_credentials: Created via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md: admin@dynasty8.no (admin) + sara@dynasty8.no (ansatt). Tokens ephemeral.
seed_data_creation: 2 users + 2 sessions inserted into test_database; sales created and deleted by tests (TEST_Ola).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use mongosh snippet in /app/auth_testing.md to mint fresh tokens. Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_dynasty8.py. Price calc canonical case: Oslo Sentrum/MLO/garasje+hage/2 tenants/10% = 27810.
